Build `vis42.mcpb`: Claude Desktop MCP Bundle, Node.js stdio-to-HTTP proxy to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`. See MCPB MANIFEST.md and README.md.

Answer `initialize` immediately; connect lazily on first request. Reuse `remoteClient` or `connectPromise`; request handlers await `getRemoteClient()`. Never block in startup with `await connectToRemote(); // this will timeout Claude Desktop`.

Transport constructors never throw. Errors surface only when `client.connect()` is awaited. SSE fallback: construct `StreamableHTTPClientTransport`, await `client.connect(transport)`; on failure log `StreamableHTTP failed (${err.message}), retrying with SSE...`, construct `SSEClientTransport`, then await `client.connect(sseTransport)` and let it throw naturally if SSE also fails.

All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel. Use `process.stderr.write(`[vis42-proxy] ${msg}\n`)`; never use `console.log` for debug output.
